data.name: Lights Of DunHuang
data.detailed_description:
A mural-restoration journey through the Mogao Caves

Lights Of DunHuang recasts the classic Zuma marble-shooter as the work of an apprentice painter in 11th-century Dunhuang. As Western Xia cavalry closes on Shazhou, you inherit the "Flowing-Light Brush" of the last Color-Sealer and walk cave to cave, restoring sutra illustrations before war can erase them.

Story

Year 1036, Song dynasty. The Guiyi Army is failing; Western Xia horsemen ride toward Shazhou. The last Color-Sealer has died; his brush falls to you. A stroke of color is not paint laid over old paint — it makes the thousand-year pigments flow again. Each mural you restore wakes a painter-spirit, and a sealed story opens.

How it plays

  • Flowing-Light Brush — your shooter, fixed at the heart of each cave. Aim, fire, swap the next pigment-ball.

  • Apsara Ribbons — pigment-balls travel along ribbons that are also the murals' composition lines.

  • Color-Setting — three or more same-colored balls fuse and dissolve into pigment. Eliminate to paint.

  • Overlapping Dye — chains deepen shade by shade; the higher your combo, the richer the bloom.

  • Spalling Gap — track's end is where the mural peels. Let the chain fall in and the painting dies.

  • Sutra-Light Ignition — clear a cave's pigment and the gray line-drawing floods into full color, gold sweeps across, a painter-spirit rises.

Six mineral pigments

Cinnabar · Orpiment · Malachite-Green · Lapis-Lazuli · Lac-Purple · Clam-Shell-White — six historical Dunhuang pigments, each with its own spectral behavior.

Tool balls mid-chain

Slow retards the stream · Reverse rolls it backward · Bomb shatters a cluster.

Ten cave sutras across six chapters

  • Chapter 1 — Caves 275 (King Sivi's Offering) & 257 (Nine-Colored Deer)

  • Chapter 2 — Caves 249 (Flying Apsaras) & 285 (Immortals)

  • Chapter 3 — Caves 420 (Bodhisattva) & 57 (Beauty Guanyin)

  • Chapter 4 — Caves 220 (Western Pure Land) & 217 (Amitayurdhyana Sutra)

  • Chapter 5 — Cave 61 (Mount Wutai Map)

  • Chapter 6 — Cave 3 (Thousand-Handed Avalokiteshvara)

data.short_description: Lights Of DunHuang recasts the classic Zuma marble-shooter as 11th-century mural restoration. Inherit the Flowing-Light Brush, fire six mineral pigment-balls along Apsara ribbons through ten Mogao Caves, chain colors into overlapping dyes, and ignite each sutra before the Spalling Gap swallows it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 1.6 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with WebGL support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Quad Core
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with WebGL2 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
